summary: Locked in the OFF-HOOK storyline spawner feature end-to-end at the API level. 14 backend pytest cases all PASS covering: (1) 400 on empty player_action, (2) 404 on unknown character, (3) off-hook action ('look for a beggar' while beat is whispering merchant) returns spawned=true, (4) chosen mission_type slug is one of {heist,rescue,assassination,political_intrigue} — never invented, (5) old storyline status flips to 'paused' with paused_at timestamp, (6) campaign doc gains pending_obligations[] entry with {storyline_id,storyline_title,summary,npc_names,location_names,paused_at,paused_at_beat}, (7) new storyline carries spawned_from={trigger:'off_hook_player_action', paused_storyline_id, player_action, reasoning}, (8) new storyline first beat tagged phase_index=0 + phase_name from chosen blueprint (Locate for rescue), (9) ON-HOOK action ('I listen to the merchant') returns spawned=false and DOES NOT pause the storyline, (10-12) prompt injection unit-tested via render_pending_obligations_for_prompt + extract_pending_obligations_from_storyline, (13-14) regression: /storylines/draft and /storylines/{id}/creative still work unchanged. Also re-ran iteration 14's 6 mission-phase-badge tests — still 100% PASS. Frontend smoke (home page) loads cleanly, no console errors. Frontend wiring verified by reading /app/frontend/src/components/ActiveInvestigationPanel.jsx callCreative (lines 228-282): correctly calls /spawn-from-action FIRST, on spawned=true shows toast 'New thread: …', replaces activeStoryline via onUpdate, calls onCreativeNarration with the new first-beat description, closes the creative dialog and returns; on spawned=false (or network error), falls through to the original /creative endpoint with the same approach_text. Full click-through e2e of the modal flow intentionally skipped — backend contract + JSX inspection are the source of truth and main agent has already manually validated the spawn flow per the request.
critical_code_review_comments: classify_action_for_spawn validates the LLM-returned slug against the campaign's available mission_types set and falls back to the first valid slug if the model hallucinates — defensive and correct.
spawn_storyline_from_action only pauses the previous storyline when status=='active' — re-spawning from an already-paused storyline won't double-pause or duplicate obligations. Good guard.

Campaign-level pending_obligations are pushed with $push (not $addToSet) — if the same storyline is paused twice across a session, you'd get duplicate entries. Minor; consider de-duping by storyline_id if it ever happens in practice.
extract_pending_obligations_from_storyline reads beats[: current+1] which correctly bounds the scan to beats the player has touched — npc/location names from future beats stay hidden.
render_pending_obligations_for_prompt caps at obligations[:4] — sensible to keep the system prompt small even when many threads are paused.

SpawnFromActionBody accepts an optional current_storyline_id — when omitted, the spawn endpoint still works (off-hook becomes effectively 'start a fresh storyline') and no pause/obligation is recorded. Reasonable.

The spawn endpoint does NOT pre-validate the current_storyline_id against the campaign — an unknown/stale id is silently ignored (current_storyline=None), which means the call returns spawned=true with paused_storyline_id=null. Acceptable but worth knowing — frontend should keep its storyline state in sync.
Spawned storyline doc carries quest_card_id+source='off-hook-spawn' on the quest card — distinguishable from regular drafts in the deck, nice for observability.
ActiveInvestigationPanel.jsx callCreative correctly awaits spawnRes.json() inside a try/catch with a fall-through to /creative on any spawn error — robust against backend downtime.

lean_dm._build_system_prompt injects the obligations_block at line 347 of the prompt template — verified by code inspection that the block is included whenever campaign.pending_obligations is non-empty.
